description: Cache dated Darwin boards/services at Cloudflare (not on the VPS). Cache key includes the full query string (date + at + hours).
expression: (http.host eq "api-raildata.railstatistics.co.uk") and (http.request.method eq "GET") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/departures/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/service/")) and (http.request.uri.query contains "date=")
